extracted.name: No Knead Bread (No Dutch Oven Needed)
extracted.description: Easy no knead bread to make without a dutch oven.
instruction_lines: Combine flour and salt in a bowl. Set aside.
Combine warm water, sugar, and yeast in a bowl or measuring cup. Stir until well combined and let sit for 5-10 minutes until frothy.
Combine wet mixture into dry ingredients. Make sure it's well incorporated.
Cover with a clean cloth or plastic wrap and let rise for 1-2 hours at warm room temperature.
Place in refrigerator for 4-12 hours. Dough will triple in size.
Remove dough from refrigerator. Flour your surface and hands to shape dough. Note it is very sticky.
Dust cookie sheet or 2 round cake pans with flour. Place dough seam down and cover with cloth for 30 minutes.
In the meanwhile preheat over at 400°. Place a cake or lasagna pan with water on lower rack. Score bread and place in rack above water.
Bake for 30-35 minutes. Remove from oven and let rest for an hour on a cooling rack before slicing.
